verdict.rationale: Paddle does not document AI insights generated inside its own dashboard. Its hosted MCP server lets external agents such as Claude or Cursor read account data and "generate reports and analyze revenue, refunds, and transaction patterns" in natural language. So AI-driven insight is reachable, but only through a third-party agent, not inside the product. The metrics and reports features in the dashboard are not described as AI-generated. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights/suggestions, proactive AI recommendations on billing data, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven analysis quality.
